notes:
Lead type: PLG/self-serve inbound from indie dev founder.
Product: VS Code extension that surfaces AI-assisted PR summaries + triage.
Workload: mix of chat (interactive assistant) and embeddings (semantic search over docs/PRs).
Traffic profile: low-to-moderate daily active users (initial target 200-2k MAU), bursty request pattern tied to dev workflows (spikes around deploy windows).
Latency target: conversational feel — usually <150ms api-to-api for short prompts; acceptable to fall back to slightly slower model for heavy summaries.
Cost sensitivity: high — founder is bootstrapped, wants predictable per-month spend caps and good estimates before committing.
Model prefs: wants a performant medium-size model (cost/latency tradeoff). Interested in Redwood-managed curated models; asked about auto-fallback to smaller quantized variants.
Security/compliance: no SSO yet; wants SOC2 information and audit logging available for later enterprise customers. No on-prem or VPC required now; public cloud acceptable.
Quotes from founder: "We need predictable bills — can't have runaway token costs during peak CI jobs."
Integration notes: using Node SDK, set up streaming for chat to improve UX. Need guidance on batching embeddings to reduce cost.
Trial behaviour: testing with ~30 sample repos, creating embeddings for PR history to prototype search.
Engagement plan: in-app product tour, templated prompt sets for PR summarization, and an "optimize" suggestion card for batching/quant settings.
Potential upsell: upgrade to paid hosted usage + Optimize recommendations; long-term Dedicated only if customer grows >50k MAU and needs SLA.
